caption: The drawing depicts a single bird resembling an ostrich standing on top of a horizontal arrow. The bird is shown in side profile facing right, with a long neck, small head, prominent beak, large body, feathered wings, and a fan-shaped tail. Both legs are visible, with claws gently resting on the straight shaft of the arrow. The arrow runs horizontally across the lower part of the image, with a pointed triangular head on the right and a detailed fletching with multiple feathers on the left. The drawing is monochromatic and executed in shades of grey, with pencil or charcoal shading used to indicate the form and texture of the bird and the arrow. The background is plain and unadorned, leaving the focus solely on the ostrich-like bird and the arrow. In the lower left corner, the text "H. BADER" is written.
title: Ostrich Weather Vane
